[[Madoran Bronzebeard|Madoran]] (ancestor) | students = [[Arthas Menethil]] }} '''Muradin Bronzebeard''' was the younger brother of the [[Dwarf|dwarven]] king [[Magni Bronzebeard]], and the older brother of the renowned explorer [[Brann Bronzebeard]]. A hero of the [[Alliance of Lordaeron]] during the [[Second War]], he later served as ambassador to [[Lordaeron (kingdom)|Lordaeron]] until the [[Third War]], where he also befriended the young [[Arthas Menethil|Prince Arthas Menethil]] and trained him in combat.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_III:_Reign_of_Chaos_Game_Manual#Human_History Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos Game Manual#Human History] Muradin was one of the first dwarves to establish the [[Explorer's Guild]], a group dedicated to archaeology and exploration of the unknown world.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_III:_Reign_of_Chaos_Game_Manual#Muradin_Bronzebeard Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos manual#Muradin Bronzebeard] Muradin perished in [[Northrend]] when Arthas claimed the runeblade [[Frostmourne]] during his quest to destroy the dreadlord [[Mal'Ganis]].[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Frostmourne_(WC3_Human) Frostmourne (WC3 Human)] ==References== {{reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Bronzebeard, Muradin}} [[Category:Dwarf characters]] [[Category:Deceased characters]] [[Category:Explorers' League]] [[Category:Lore characters]]
